baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled س ن ن at words 1 and 10 encloses the earlier dispatches and the negated تَحْوِيلًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sunnah is a running route instantiated by successive dispatched messengers; قَبْلَ orders its prior instances, and the final negation blocks shifting that governing course into another state.

activation_trace.role: A running, followed road supplies the invariant course.
Dispatch supplies repeated enactment rather than an abstract rule alone.
Successive groups make the messengers ordered cohorts on one course.
Temporal precedence locates earlier instances of the same course.
Change of state or place names the shift denied of the course.

changed_reading.before: A fixed divine custom concerning earlier messengers.
changed_reading.after: A repeatable route enacted by successive dispatches, whose governing course cannot be shifted.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: سُنَّةَ and سُنَّتِنَا repeat around forms of ر س ل before the denial of transformation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The easy continuous pour of س ن ن and the smooth, successive movement of ر س ل recast precedent as an unbroken transmission stream; تَحْوِيلًا would be its diversion into another channel.

activation_trace.role: A smooth continuous pour gives sunnah the material behavior of an unbroken stream.
Smooth movement makes each dispatch travel within that stream.
Cohort after cohort supplies continuity through plurality.
Transfer from state or place supplies the prohibited rerouting.

changed_reading.before: The verse asserts that a rule does not change.
changed_reading.after: The verse pictures one continuous transmission moving through many messengers without being rerouted.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The second clause is observer-facing: وَلَا تَجِدُ governs a nominal تَحْوِيلًا directed toward لِسُنَّتِنَا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The denial closes both discovery and capacity: no instance of conversion can be found, and no available power or stratagem can produce one.

activation_trace.role: Finding or encountering turns immutability into an unsuccessfully searchable exception.
Capacity and means extend the denial from observation to effective counter-power.
Cunning and power to act specify the unavailable mechanism of conversion.
The followed course is what neither exception nor counter-capacity can redirect.

changed_reading.after: Every search for an exception, resource, or stratagem able to redirect the practiced course fails.

context_deltas.mechanism: Submission is contested by a program of destabilization, but that program is explicitly bounded by denied coercive authority and a sufficient guardian. The focus invariant therefore acquires a jurisdictional edge: agitation can operate without transferring the protected order.

activation_trace.role: Lowering and submission establish the relation that refusal contests.
Lightness that shakes stability supplies the adversarial operation.
Power and jurisdiction name what the adversary is denied.
One who sufficiently guards an affair supplies the counter-boundary.
The running order persists through, rather than outside, the contest.
The denied state-transfer marks the limit of destabilization.

structural_cues: 17:61-65 moves from commanded prostration and refusal through mobilization to the explicit denial of authority over the marked servants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies submission, destabilizing mobilization, denied authority, and sufficient guardianship; I infer that these delimit where the focus invariant operates; alternatively, the sequence may contrast agents without defining the scope of sunnah.

changed_reading.after: The path remains jurisdictionally untransferable even while solicitation and destabilization remain active.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gentle propulsion leads into danger, rescue separates people from danger, and landfall is followed by turning away and covering the benefit; return to the sea begins another instance. Human states repeatedly convert, while the containing sequence does not.

activation_trace.role: Gentle driving initiates the movement through states.
Rescue as separating release supplies the decisive transition out of danger.
Turning one's side away supplies the post-rescue reversal.
Covering a benefit characterizes the recurrent human response.
Return after departure closes the loop back into exposure.
A returning occurrence makes the loop explicitly iterative.
Continuous flow recasts sunnah as the stable containing sequence.
State-change is abundant inside the cycle but denied of the cycle itself.

structural_cues: 17:66-69 orders propulsion, danger, exclusive appeal, rescue, landfall, turning away, and a return for another exposure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered transitions and explicit return; I infer a higher-order invariant that contains lower-order reversals; alternatively, the episodes may be parallel warnings rather than one cycle.

changed_reading.after: No change means invariant recurrence: rapidly changing human states reproduce the same governing sequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Three preceding negated searches remove, in turn, a guardian, a claimant who could pursue the matter, and a helper. The focus repeats the same finding verb and replaces absent agents with absent conversion, closing the search field around the divine course itself.

activation_trace.role: The first failed finding opens the repeated search formula.
A guardian sufficient for the affair is the first unavailable resource.
The second failed finding repeats and enlarges the search.
A pursuer or claimant for a right is the second unavailable recourse.
The third failed finding applies the formula directly to the addressed messenger.
Aid that makes one prevail is the final unavailable agent.
The focus repetition turns failed search from missing agents to a missing exception.
Unavailable power or stratagem is condensed into the absent conversion.

structural_cues: The sequence repeats لا تجدوا in 17:68 and 17:69, لا تجد in 17:75, and ولا تجد in 17:77 while changing the searched-for complement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated negated verb and progressively different complements; I infer an escalation from absent representatives to absent exception-making capacity; alternatively, the repetition may be cohesion without a semantic escalation.

changed_reading.before: One cannot discover a change in divine practice.
changed_reading.after: After every proxy and helper has been removed from the search, conversion itself is exposed as the final unavailable recourse.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding counterfactual makes the addressed messenger experience doubled consequence and no aid if he leans. The rule across messengers therefore includes their own non-exempt accountability, not only what happens to their opponents.

activation_trace.role: Experiential testing makes the threatened consequence personally undergone.
Addition of an equal amount makes the consequence explicitly doubled.
Loss of life and force marks the second domain of doubled consequence.
Unavailable aid removes a personal exemption through rescue.
Messenger and carried message define the office placed under the rule.
The same followed judgment spans prior messengers and the present addressee.

structural_cues: 17:74-75 addresses the messenger in a counterfactual second person immediately before 17:77 invokes prior messengers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a doubled counterfactual consequence with no helper and then the cross-messenger rule; I infer that messenger accountability is one application of that rule; alternatively, the warning and the historical rule may remain distinct.

changed_reading.before: The invariant chiefly predicts what communities do to messengers and what follows.
changed_reading.after: The invariant also binds the messenger: office does not transfer him outside the accountability governing prior envoys.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pressure attempts to tilt the messenger away from received communication toward a fabricated substitute and rewarded intimacy; divine strengthening prevents even slight leaning. The unconvertible sunnah is thus also a non-substitutable commission.

activation_trace.role: Tilting from truth supplies the attempted deflection.
Communication from God supplies the content under pressure.
Fabricated falsehood supplies the proposed counterfeit.
Changing an image or replacing a thing makes substitution explicit.
Strengthening and fixation supply the force resisting deflection.
Inclining and settling toward another side identifies the almost-realized shift.
The messenger as carrier of a message ties the invariant to transmission integrity.
The followed course is the commission that pressure cannot replace.
Change from one state to another names the blocked substitution.

structural_cues: 17:73 contrasts what was communicated with a requested other version; 17:74 makes stabilization the condition preventing inclination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies received communication, attempted fabrication and replacement, inclination, and stabilization; I infer that the focus rule includes integrity of commission; alternatively, sunnah may refer only to the aftermath of expulsion in 17:76.

changed_reading.before: The same external history recurs around every messenger.
changed_reading.after: The commission itself is non-substitutable: social pressure cannot convert a sent message into an alternate one.

context_deltas.mechanism: A community nearly shakes the messenger loose from the land to force him out, but its own stay behind him becomes short. The focus identifies that reversal as the recurring envoy-pattern: displacement pressure rebounds as loss of tenure for the expellers.

activation_trace.role: Shaking stability supplies the coercive attempt to dislodge.
Ground beneath the sky supplies the contested domain of tenure.
Passing outside supplies the intended forced displacement.
Remaining in a place becomes the consequence measured against expulsion.
Being behind or after the messenger supplies the reversed temporal position.
Smallness makes the expellers' remaining tenure brief.
Successive messenger cohorts make the reversal historically recurrent.
The followed route names the recurrence of displacement and rebound.
No state-transfer prevents the expellers from redirecting the consequence.

structural_cues: 17:76 gives a conditional expulsion followed by a short post-messenger stay, and 17:77 immediately names the pattern of earlier messengers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attempted expulsion and abbreviated residence followed by the messenger precedent; I infer a rebound from displaced envoy to displaced expellers; alternatively, the short stay may be one example within a broader unnamed rule.

changed_reading.before: Earlier messengers establish a general precedent.
changed_reading.after: The precise precedent is a tenure reversal: forcing out the envoy cannot preserve the expellers' own place after him.

context_deltas.mechanism: People are called by an orienting leader, receive a binding record, and carry present blindness onto a more lost path. This strengthens the path sense of sunnah: alignment becomes legible and persists into reckoning rather than being reset by a later scene.

activation_trace.role: A leader followed by others supplies communal orientation.
A written determination that obligates supplies durable legibility.
Blindness of insight persists across the two stated domains.
An extended traversable road makes loss directional.
The followed road becomes the stable frame within which orientation is disclosed.
Facing and orientation let prior messenger history confront the present addressee.

structural_cues: 17:71-72 joins communal leadership, readable record, repeated blindness, and a path before the pressure narratives of 17:73-76.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies leader, binding record, persistent blindness, and path; I infer that the focus course preserves and exposes orientation through time; alternatively, this may prepare judgment without specifying the messenger-sunnah.

changed_reading.before: Sunnah is chiefly an event-pattern around envoys.
changed_reading.after: Sunnah is also an orienting route on which affiliations and present blindness remain legible at reckoning.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins material branches rather than asserting their ordinary contextual senses; it remains anchored in focus س ن ن and تَحْوِيلًا and is activated by adjacent assay and strengthening language; downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for tested stability.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sharpening branch of the repeated س ن ن and the denied state-change in تَحْوِيلًا.

activation_trace.role: Sharpening and polishing make the invariant course a worked edge.
Assaying metal or a person supplies the testing pressure on that edge.
Strengthening supplies the result that preserves the tested line.
Denied transformation prevents testing from becoming transmutation.

changed_reading.before: Pressure merely threatens deviation from a fixed rule.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, pressure assays and sharpens the commissioned line without transmuting it into another line.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the packet's non-dominant ج د د mapping for focus و ج د; it remains formally anchored to word 9 and gains a coherent cut-substitute mechanism from 17:73; downstream prose must label it an exploratory anti-splicing image, not a lexical gloss of تَجِدُ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 9 maps not only to و ج د but also to the packet's ج د د inventory, alongside the explicit denial of transforming sunnah.

activation_trace.role: Newness arising after a cut supplies the image of inaugurating a replacement regime.
Cutting in order to repair and stitch supplies the attempted splice.
Replacement by another makes the intended splice a substitution.
The established route is what the proposed cut-and-splice cannot supersede.
Denied conversion blocks the stitched substitute from becoming a new governing state.

changed_reading.before: No alternate wording can change the established messenger-pattern.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the pressured fabrication is a cut-and-splice attempt that cannot inaugurate a new regime after severing the received line.

strongest_changes: The sea-to-land-return sequence turns static immutability into an invariant that contains repeated human reversals.
Repeated negated finding clauses remove guardian, claimant, helper, and finally conversion itself.
The revelation-pressure sequence makes sunnah a non-substitutable commission as well as a historical precedent.
The adjacent expulsion conditional specifies a tenure reversal that recurs across messenger cohorts.
summary.what_was_special: The packet made no-transformation dynamic: destabilization, rescue, apostasy-like reversal, counterfeit pressure, stabilization, and expulsion all move, while the higher-order envoy course and its accountability remain untransferred.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the maritime recurrence belongs directly to the messenger-sunnah or only supplies a nearby analogy.
Whether the no-finder series is a deliberate escalation from absent agents to absent conversion or primarily verbal cohesion.
Whether non-substitutability of revelation is part of sunnah itself or a distinct lead-in to the expulsion precedent.
The assay and cut-and-splice readings depend on deliberately exploratory branch activation and should not be promoted to ordinary lexical readings.
